kernel_printed_types.CCCGeometry.quartic_root_expansion:
CCCGeometry.quartic_root_expansion (a b c d e r x : ℝ) :
  a * (r + x) ^ 4 + b * (r + x) ^ 3 + c * (r + x) ^ 2 + d * (r + x) + e =
    a * r ^ 4 + b * r ^ 3 + c * r ^ 2 + d * r + e + (4 * a * r ^ 3 + 3 * b * r ^ 2 + 2 * c * r + d) * x +
          (6 * a * r ^ 2 + 3 * b * r + c) * x ^ 2 +
        (4 * a * r + b) * x ^ 3 +
      a * x ^ 4
kernel_printed_types.CCCGeometry.quartic_root_reciprocal:
CCCGeometry.quartic_root_reciprocal (a b c d e r u : ℝ) (hu : u ≠ 0)
  (hr : a * r ^ 4 + b * r ^ 3 + c * r ^ 2 + d * r + e = 0) :
  u ^ 4 * (a * (r + 1 / u) ^ 4 + b * (r + 1 / u) ^ 3 + c * (r + 1 / u) ^ 2 + d * (r + 1 / u) + e) =
    (4 * a * r ^ 3 + 3 * b * r ^ 2 + 2 * c * r + d) * u ^ 3 + (6 * a * r ^ 2 + 3 * b * r + c) * u ^ 2 +
        (4 * a * r + b) * u +
      a
kernel_printed_types.CCCGeometry.cubic_weierstrass_identity:
CCCGeometry.cubic_weierstrass_identity (A B C D u : ℝ) :
  A ^ 2 * (A * u ^ 3 + B * u ^ 2 + C * u + D) =
    (A * u + B / 3) ^ 3 + (A * C - B ^ 2 / 3) * (A * u + B / 3) + (2 * B ^ 3 / 27 - A * B * C / 3 + A ^ 2 * D)
kernel_printed_types.CCCGeometry.cubic_solution_transport:
CCCGeometry.cubic_solution_transport (A B C D u v : ℝ) (h : v ^ 2 = A * u ^ 3 + B * u ^ 2 + C * u + D) :
  (A * v) ^ 2 =
    (A * u + B / 3) ^ 3 + (A * C - B ^ 2 / 3) * (A * u + B / 3) + (2 * B ^ 3 / 27 - A * B * C / 3 + A ^ 2 * D)
